name: lumi-skill-cad-drafting
description: CAD and renovation design delivery pack for space programs, customer-facing proposal decks, editable DXF drafts, Revit/Dynamo handoff data, and drawing QA checklists.

lumi.setupNote: Reads local renovation folders and can generate customer-facing proposal content, editable DXF drafts, Revit/Dynamo handoff data, proposal notes, and material lists. Open generated DXF in real CAD software when available. Production drawings still require professional verification.
